en: Have a good time.
Welcome.
How do I get into the casino?
I don't know what you mean. This is a bar.
Yeah, shoulda figured ya'd want a tip. How much?
I really have no idea what you're talking about. There's no gambling here. If it's a <Italic>drink</Italic> you want, I can do that. We are a bar, you know.
(He's not bitin'. What's up with this?)
Evening. Interested in the casino?
Evening.
Hey, do you shoot pool? I'm so tired of playing the regulars here. Can I challenge you to a match?
Sorry, not now.
Don't you want to know how to get into the casino?
Who are ya?
That's not important. But come on, how about it? If you win, I'll tell you how to get in.
Or, if you're not much of a pool player...
Well, I've already said too much. Why don't you forget we ever talked, and I'll let you settle my bar tab today. Fifty grand.
Yeah, I'll take ya on.
Very well. May the best man win.
Don't got time to play. Here, how's this?
You paid <Color:8>50,000 yen<Color:Default>.
Hm, disappointing. Well, I'll just drown my sorrows in alcohol, then.
Sorry to say, I ain't got the cash.
How about we play for it, then? That is, unless you're scared I'll beat you...
Well, I got nowhere else to be. Come back and let me know if you can work up the guts to challenge me...
Sorry, but I can't trust ya.
Tch, it's not like you have any other leads, do you?
Whatever. But if you change your mind, come on back here. I got nowhere else to be.
Haha! I knew I'd win, hahaha.
(What a blowhard.)
Hah, don't take it too hard. I'm available for a rematch any time...
Oof! That hurts!
Tell me about the casino. You promised.
Yeah, okay. So the club had to change its system after the police cracked down on it.
Now you have to have a pass to get in.
Okay. Where do I get one?
That, I don't know. Kiyotaka might, though...
Who's that?
He's this homeless guy. He's really old.
An old, homeless guy knows. Real classy place, this casino's gotta be. Have any idea where this guy is?
Nah. But I mean, wouldn't he go somewhere he'd be sheltered? That's what I would do, heck...
Ya mean somewhere with a roof? I doubt he'd be allowed to loiter in stores.
(Come to think of it, there was that covered shoppin' area in Tsukimino. He'd be sheltered without havin' to go inside the stores there.)
'Kay, I'm gonna go find 'im.
Good luck.
You again? Did you find out how many homeless there are?
(This guy's s'posed to like booze, right? I could give 'im some.)
(Not worth it.)
Hey, ya thirsty?
Trying to ply me with alcohol, are you? I'm not falling for that shit! ...Okay, okay, you can buy me a drink.
Oho, this is mighty fine! All right, lad, ask me anything ya like!
I'll repeat my question. According to the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare, how many homeless were there in Hokkaido in January 2012?
(There. Is that Kiyotaka?)
Say, are you Kiyotaka?
Why do you wanna know? What're you accusing me of?
Ain't accusin' ya of nothin'. I just want a pass to get into the hidden casino at Ambitious. It's a bar.
Well, you know, we homeless get accused of everything⑬that's if we're not just outright ignored! Do you even know how many of us were in Hokkaido in January 2012?
Consider this a pop quiz for the prize you seek. It's a real number⑬the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare counted us up. Quick, quick, how many?
(How many homeless? Uh...)
Bzzzt. Wrong! And I'm not talking unless you get it right.
(Wow. What does this fella want me to do? Research shit?)
That's correct! Wow, I didn't expect that. How did you know? Are you the most well-researched guy in town, or just a lucky guesser?
So, 'bout that pass...
You got <Color:8>Phone Booth Photo<Color:Default>.
A photo of a certain spot in town. Keep an eye out for it. It will lead you to what you seek.
Find the place in the photo. Got it.
Hello. How may I help you?
(What'd the voice on the phone say? The first bit of the password was...)
(The next bit of the password was...)
(And then finally...)
One random losing ticket.
One random winning ticket.
One random three-year-old ticket.
One consecutive losing ticket.
One consecutive winning ticket.
One consecutive three-year-old ticket.
One scattered losing ticket.
One scattered winning ticket.
One scattered three-year-old ticket.
Seven random losing tickets.
Seven random winning tickets.
Seven random three-year-old tickets.
Seven consecutive losing tickets.
Seven consecutive winning tickets.
Seven consecutive three-year-old tickets.
Seven scattered losing tickets.
Seven scattered winning tickets.
Seven scattered three-year-old tickets.
Nine random losing tickets.
Nine random winning tickets.
Nine random three-year-old tickets.
Nine consecutive losing tickets.
Nine consecutive winning tickets.
Nine consecutive three-year-old tickets.
Nine scattered losing tickets.
Nine scattered winning tickets.
Nine scattered three-year old tickets.
Um...
Could you not fool around, please?
(Guess that was wrong.)
I know what that means!
You got <Color:8>Underground Casino Pass<Color:Default>.
May Lady Luck be with you!
'Preciate it.
(Finally got the damn pass! Now back to Ambitious.)
Heyyy...
Huh? Well, look who it is!
Long time, no see. Care for a refreshment?
You handed over <Color:8>Lots of Liquor<Color:Default>.
Aw, you're the best, man! This is perfect for the cold. There'll be a party tonight, that's for sure.
Yo, there's someone I need you to find for me. He's the president of a company called MAO, Inc.
Heh. Dumb name for a company. But yeah, I'll see if anyone knows.
That'd be a huge help. Here's ten yen to call me when you know something.
Is this really gonna work?
Yep. They've got a robust network for swapping info. Let's walk around until he calls me.
Just so you know, I'm not Tojo Clan. Just a regular civilian. Now tell me, where can I find your boss?
Urgh, I dunno. Haven't seen him since yesterday. He went in to HQ, but never came back out.
Dammit, he better still be alive. Guess I'll have to find someone who knows what they're talking about.
Are you Yahata's men?
And what if we are? Who's askin'?
I've got business with your boss. Where can I find him?
<Italic>You</Italic>? Why would some civilian wanna... No, this guy's gotta be Tojo Clan!
Hey! We got one of those Tojo pricks here! Let's bash his face in!
Now then. Tell me where Yahata is.
Grr... You're not gettin' a goddamn thing outta me!
This isn't a joke. I'm trying to stop a war with the Tojo Clan here.
Yeah, well what's the point of bein' yakuza if y'can't fight when it really matters?
Besides, I ain't got a clue where the boss is at. Same goes for Patriarch Madarame. Whole damn family's goin' down the gutter fast.
Guess someone else will have to tell me what I want to know.
(So Yahata's own family doesn't even know where he is. Gotta keep looking.)
You're with the Yahata Family, right? Mind telling me where your boss is?
Who the hell are you? Y'think I'm just gonna spill my guts to some nobody off the street?
I'm doing a favor for your patriarch. It's urgent.
Madarame? Hold up, what's the deal here?
Hey, this guy's gotta be one of them Tojo goons! Let's take his ass out!
See the homeless guy over there? Boy, does he love booze!
He's a stubborn old fuck, but I bet he'd mellow out if you offered him a drink.
Were you talking to that old panhandler?
Yeah, what about it?
Tch, he's made himself right at home around here. I understand he likes the roof, but he's a real nuisance for the shops.
I mean, there are only 71 homeless people in all of Hokkaido. Figures we'd have to end up with one...
Wait, how many homeless did ya say?
Seventy-one. You can look it up online.
That so...
Hey, you're that lost fellow Okudera-san found.
Sure am. Ya want somethin'?
Don't know how long you're staying here, or why you'd even want to stay long... but there's something you ought to know about our village.
Up past here, there's a small shrine. They say it was built at the same time as the village, to provide protection.
Now, a strange old fellow named Tendo calls it home. You have to watch out for him.
How strange are we talkin'?
Like beyond strange. He looks like a sage out of a storybook, and rumor has it he can use sorcery...
Heh. You believe in that stuff?
If you're really not scared, then go see him for yourself! But don't say I didn't warn you.
(A sorcerer in a mountain shrine, huh? Sounds interestin'.)
It'd be nice to go out together for old time's sake, Uncle Kaz.
Now isn't a good time. We'll do it another day.
Okay, sure. I'm looking forward to it.
Sure, let's go.
Yay! I'll get ready.
Oh, hello, Haruka-chan. What's up?
Good luck with the Princess thing.

Well, Hana-chan hasn't called yet. Maybe I'd better get some
done. What are your plans now?

I think I'll go back to my apartment and try to get myself
geared up for the Princess League.
Great. Good idea.
All right, thank you. I'll be going, then.
Oh, hello, Haruka-chan. Any news?
Come back anytime. I might be out, uh, working, though.

Hmm. Maybe I'd better get some work done. What are your
plans now?

I think I'll go back to my apartment and try to get my
thoughts together.
Good thinking. Try to take it easy if you can.
Oh, hello. Please come in. I'll make some tea.

You must be busy getting ready. I won't be staying, so don't
go to any trouble.

Well, sorry to bother you. Are you all set for the Princess
League?
I think I need to do a little more.

Yamaura-san's waiting for you at Dyna Chair, right? Head on
over when you're ready.
Okay, be seeing you.
I think I'll go to Dyna Chair.

Yeah, Yamaura-san's waiting for you, isn't she? Good luck
with the Princess thing.
"The Princess League." And thank you. I'll be going, then.
Oh, hello. Please come in. I'll make us some tea.
Oh, don't go to any trouble. I'll only be staying for a minute.

Well, sorry to bother you. Glad to see you're holding up
pretty well.
I'm all right. Thank you.

Heh, I thought maybe you'd be at your wits end by now. But I
guess that'd be pretty out of character for you, wouldn't it?
Well, be seeing you.

I think I'll try going out for a while. Maybe I'll ask for
some lessons at the office.

Good thinking. A little exercise'll probably do you some
good right now.
I'll be at Sky Finance if you need me. Swing by anytime.
Okay, thank you. See you later.
Thank you for coming. This way, please.
This is <Italic>so</Italic> stupid. I am <Italic>never</Italic> going back to Kamurocho Hills <Italic>again</Italic>!
Don't worry, we can always pick another restaurant. Actually, I just thought of somewhere pretty good.
But I wanted to go to the one in the Hills! What do they mean it's "closed for inspection"? I'm gonna call and complain later.

Come on, don't do that. It's important that buildings be
inspected every now and then⑬for safety!
Then you should've <Italic>inspected</Italic> our plans beforehand, dummy!
(So Kamurocho Hills is shut down... Then the enemy is waiting for us.)
(Kamurocho Hills is shut down, huh... Guess the enemy's up there.)
Those were yakuza back at the Hills, I'm sure of it.
Yep, definitely yakuza. No mistaking it.

Man, it's like the yakuza control Kamurocho. Guess it really
does have a dark side... I should post this up on Chatter.

Hells to the yeah, my dude. Check out what I'm gonna post!
"Yakuza on the prowl in Kamurocho Hills." Heheh. Siiiick.
Hey, if it isn't Ebi-chan.
Huh? Saejima-san!? Why are you in Kamurocho?
I've got some things to take care of. Are you here for that big tournament you were talkin' about?
Yeah, that's right! I ended up tying with this lady here in the finals. It was a great game!
Your trainin' paid off, then.
Yeah, and get this! I actually won the whole thing!
That's great, Ebi-chan! Your trainin' paid off, then.
Yeah! Kind of a bummer, though. I made it all the way to the final round, but ended up losing. It was a really great game, though!
I see. That's too bad.
All in all, it was a great experience. Well, I'll see you back in Tsukimino!
All in all, it was a great experience. I'm really grateful for your help.
Shino?
Wait, huh? Why are you in Kamurocho? Well, I guess it doesn't matter.
I entered that darts tournament I told you about, and tied this guy in the finals. Sucks that I didn't win, but it was a pretty good game.
Your practice paid off, then.
I entered that darts tournament I told you about, and ended up winning the whole thing!
